answer: Locks are recorded in gale, expire in walnut, and thread lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 31 aliases as a result needs 186 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2415 identities would post 1115 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
